title: Bounded Worker Control Framing and NUL-Delimited IPC Streams

claims.assertion: Long-running binary reversing sub-processes (Ghidra, Rizin, Hopper) must enforce bounded line buffers and NUL-delimited/length-prefixed message boundaries to prevent pipe buffer deadlocks.
